prompt:
Create one landscape 3:2 Minecraft architectural MOOD BOARD on a plain warm light background, crisp vanilla Minecraft voxel renders, for a public Minecraft Java 1.21.1 build catalog. Title: "PIER 59 • SEATTLE AQUARIUM • WATERFRONT LANDINGS". No characters or animals. All constructed geometry uses actual vanilla blocks available in 1.21.1, no pale oak, no custom models or textures. Dusk illumination within the miniature scenes, warm windows and lanterns, while the sheet stays light and clean.

Layout: upper two-thirds has THREE small complete waterfront ensemble thumbnail takes, each showing ALL FOUR modules, recognisably the same buildings, with subtle alternate roof detailing, bay rhythms and terrace arrangements. Label "01 / HISTORIC PIER", "02 / BAY & DECKS", "03 / ALASKAN WAY". Preserve the buildings' site orientation in each take; change camera or small detailing, never rotate modules relative to site. Each ensemble includes a long pale timber Pier 59 shed on visible dark timber piles over blue water with a long dark gray gabled roof, glazed modern street entrance at its high-x east end lettered "SEATTLE AQUARIUM", abstract sea-life block mosaic on a wall; low concrete and glass 1980 Bay Wing at the seaward end with open rooftop water pools, railed viewing decks and a faceted glass underwater-dome hall; two separate four-to-six-storey Waterfront Landings residential blocks on the landward side, pale stucco above reddish brick bases, repeated projecting bay windows, balconies, stepped flat roofs and roof terraces, warmly lit ground shops facing Alaskan Way on high x. Retain open courtyard notches in the Landings footprints. No invented tall towers or grand aquarium domes.

Site and scale: 1.4 blocks per metre. Low x = west / Elliott Bay / downhill; high x = east / Alaskan Way / uphill; low z = northwest, high z = southeast. Pier 59 footprint is a long diagonal northwest-to-southeast narrow pier band with irregular widened seaward head; Bay Wing is an irregular low mass at that head. Landings North and South are two distinct courtyard-notched blocks along the street, North at low z and South at high z. Include a small x/z orientation key. Detailed site boxes: Pier 59 x18..137 z342..513 roof about y26; Bay Wing x86..134 z330..424 roof about y18; Landings North x173..238 z27..137 roof about y29; South x177..239 z143..245 roof about y28. These are separate footprint modules, not a row of four buildings on an arbitrary straight base. Respect footprint silhouettes and show pile supports or foundations meeting the ground, never floating or buried. Ground mostly y3 on pier, y0..5 Bay Wing, y0..2 Landings. Exterior only with light visible immediately behind glass.

Middle narrow palette strip: small voxel block swatches arranged by role, every block with its EXACT identifier clearly lettered beneath in legible monospace. WALLS: minecraft:birch_planks, minecraft:smooth_sandstone, minecraft:bricks. TRIM: minecraft:smooth_quartz. ROOF: minecraft:deepslate_tiles. WINDOWS: minecraft:light_blue_stained_glass. ACCENTS: minecraft:dark_oak_log, minecraft:iron_bars, minecraft:lantern, minecraft:cyan_concrete. Give sufficient room for the full identifiers; use two neat rows if needed.

Bottom row: FOUR framed enlarged crisp voxel construction detail callouts, with thin leader lines and short captions: (1) "GABLED EAVE / TIMBER PILES" showing the deepslate stair-and-slab eave, pale timber wall, deck and piles meeting water; (2) "GLASS ENTRY / AQUARIUM SIGN" showing warm glazed doors, exact SEATTLE AQUARIUM lettering and a cyan/blue abstract sea-life mural made of blocks, no living creatures; (3) "BAY WING / POOL & DOME" showing empty rooftop water pool, iron-bar rail and small faceted glass dome; (4) "LANDINGS / BAYS & BALCONIES" showing pale facade, brick shop base, projecting window bay, balcony rail, roof terrace and warm lantern. Beautiful restrained architecture study sheet, clearly separated panels, precise block edges, no photographic textures, no interiors beyond glass, no people, no mobs.
reads: Pier 59’s long dark gray gabled roof above pale timber walls.
Exposed dark timber piles, waterfront decking, and railings.
Glazed entrance beneath the SEATTLE AQUARIUM sign.
Blue and cyan sea-life wall mosaic.
Low Bay Wing with open water pools, viewing decks, and a faceted glass dome.
Two separate Waterfront Landings blocks with pale façades and reddish brick shop bases.
Repeated projecting bay windows, balconies, and planted rooftop terraces.
Warm window light and lanterns reflected in the bay at dusk.
